description: Use this when the signed-in owner wants to see this week's posts, what's coming up, or what a post looks like. Returns each post's caption, hashtags, day and status (being made, ready to review, waiting for approval, scheduled, posted), shown in the Suara viewer with every slide. Give postId to see one post. Read only. Nothing is posted.

images.description: Also attach the pictures to the answer (default false: the Suara viewer shows them)

postId.description: Only this post (with every carousel slide)

name: get_my_posts
title: Show my posts
